transcript: One model, one time frame, three easy steps, and guys, this has gotten me over a 90 % win rate over the past two months, so listen up because I'm only going to teach you this one time. First, we want to see what direction price is moving. Are we trending up, or are we trending down? In this case, we can clearly see that price is trending up, making higher highs and higher lows. Most traders would see this as an opportunity to go long, but stop, that's exactly why 99 % of traders are unprofitable. We want to wait for a breakout and catch the entire move down. The first thing we want to do is mark out a trend line. Since we're currently trending up, we want to mark out a bullish trend line. Next, we want to zoom in and find the highest timeframe bullish fair value gap of the current trading range, and as you can see, we have this perfect two minute right here. We now have all of our support levels marked out, so all we have to do is wait for a candle to close below them. And as you can see in the very next candle, that's exactly what we get. This confirms we're breaking up to the downside, so we can now enter a short position. Make sure to put your stop loss just above the inverse fair value gap, and simply target the bottom of the marked out trend line.
